subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: What I look for first in clothes is not trendiness, but whether I can actually imagine living in them.
portuguese: A primeira coisa que procuro na roupa não é estar na moda, mas perceber se me consigo imaginar a viver com ela.
pronunciationNote: ah pree-MAIR-ah KOY-zah k proh-KOO-roo nah ROH-pah nown eh esh-TAR nah MOH-dah, mahz pair-seh-BER s m kon-SEE-goo ee-mah-zhee-NAR ah vee-VAIR kong EH-lah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se só funciona em teoria, raramente a vou usar de verdade.
exampleSentences.english: If it only works in theory, I will rarely wear it in real life.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I have become much more selective about fabric, because comfort changes how confident I feel in something.
portuguese: Fiquei muito mais seletivo com os tecidos, porque o conforto muda a forma como me sinto em confiança com uma peça.
pronunciationNote: fee-KAY MOOY-too mysh seh-leh-TEE-voo kong oosh teh-SEE-doosh, poor-k oo kon-FOR-too MOO-dah ah FOR-mah KOH-moo m SEEN-too eng kon-fee-AN-sah kong OO-mah PESS-ah
notes: Useful in style and shopping conversations.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se estou sempre a ajustar a roupa, deixo de estar presente no resto.
exampleSentences.english: If I am constantly adjusting my clothes, I stop being present for anything else.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I do not mind repeating clothes if they still feel like me and work in different situations.
portuguese: Não me importo de repetir roupa se ela continua a parecer-me minha e funciona em situações diferentes.
pronunciationNote: nown m eem-POR-too d rreh-peh-TEER ROH-pah s EH-lah kon-TEE-noo-ah ah pah-REH-sair-m MEE-nyah ee foon-see-OH-nah eng see-too-ah-SOINSH dee-feh-REN-tesh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim, o valor está mais no uso do que na novidade.
exampleSentences.english: For me, the value lies more in use than in novelty.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The problem with some formal clothes is not that they look bad, but that they make me move differently.
portuguese: O problema com alguma roupa formal não é ficar mal, mas obrigar-me a mover-me de outra forma.
pronunciationNote: oo proh-BLAY-mah kong al-GOO-mah ROH-pah for-MAL nown eh fee-KAR mal, mahz ob-ree-GAR-m ah moh-VAIR-m d OH-trah FOR-mah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando uma peça me prende demasiado, nota-se logo na postura.
exampleSentences.english: When a piece constrains me too much, you notice it immediately in my posture.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I usually decide against something if I have to keep convincing myself that it works.
portuguese: Normalmente desisto de uma peça se tenho de continuar a convencer-me de que funciona.
pronunciationNote: nor-mal-MEN-t deh-ZEES-too d OO-mah PESS-ah s TEN-yoo d kon-tee-NOO-ahr ah kon-ven-SAIR-m d k foon-see-OH-nah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando é certo, costuma ser muito mais imediato.
exampleSentences.english: When it is right, it is usually much more immediate.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I am less interested in looking polished all the time than in feeling coherent in what I wear.
portuguese: Interessa-me menos parecer impecável o tempo todo do que sentir coerência naquilo que visto.
pronunciationNote: een-teh-REH-sah-m MEN-oosh pah-REH-sair eem-peh-KAH-vel oo TEM-poo TOH-doo doo k seen-TEER koo-eh-REN-see-ah nah-KEE-loo k VEESH-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a imagem está muito longe da forma como vivo, acaba por parecer disfarce.
exampleSentences.english: If the image is too far from the way I live, it ends up feeling like a disguise.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I like clothes that gain character with wear rather than falling apart the moment they stop looking new.
portuguese: Gosto de roupa que ganha caráter com o uso em vez de se desfazer assim que deixa de parecer nova.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too d ROH-pah k GAHN-yah kah-RAK-ter kong oo OO-zoo eng vez d s dezh-fah-ZAIR ah-SEENG k DAY-shah d pah-REH-sair NOH-vah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se uma peça só funciona no primeiro impacto, não me interessa tanto.
exampleSentences.english: If a piece only works on first impact, it does not interest me as much.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: What usually makes an outfit work is not one statement piece, but the overall balance.
portuguese: O que normalmente faz um conjunto resultar não é uma peça de destaque, mas o equilíbrio geral.
pronunciationNote: oo k nor-mal-MEN-t faz oom kon-ZHOON-too rreh-zool-TAR nown eh OO-mah PESS-ah d desh-TAK, mahz oo eh-kee-LEE-bree-oo zheh-RAL

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando tudo quer chamar atenção ao mesmo tempo, nada respira.
exampleSentences.english: When everything wants attention at once, nothing gets space to breathe.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I have learned that if shoes are wrong, the rest of the outfit hardly matters to me.
portuguese: Aprendi que, se os sapatos estiverem errados, o resto da roupa quase deixa de importar.
pronunciationNote: ah-PREN-dee k, s oosh sah-PAH-toosh esh-TEE-vair-eng eh-RRAH-doosh, oo RRESH-too dah ROH-pah KWAH-zeh DAY-shah d eem-por-TAR

exampleSentences.portuguese: São a base do conforto e também mudam muito a leitura do conjunto.
exampleSentences.english: They are the basis of comfort and they also change the reading of the whole outfit.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I prefer a wardrobe that is small but flexible over one that is large but oddly limiting.
portuguese: Prefiro um guarda-roupa pequeno mas flexível a um grande que, estranhamente, me limita mais.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo oom GWAR-dah ROH-pah peh-KEH-noo mahz flehk-SEE-vel ah oom GRAN-d k esh-tran-yah-MEN-t m lee-MEE-tah mysh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ter muita escolha não ajuda se quase nada combina ou resolve o dia a dia.
exampleSentences.english: Having a lot of choice does not help if almost nothing matches or works day to day.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I do not choose colours only by what suits me individually, but by the mood I want to create.
portuguese: Não escolho cores só pelo que me favorece individualmente, mas também pelo ambiente que quero criar.
pronunciationNote: nown esh-KOL-yoo KOH-resh soh PEL-oo k m fah-voh-REH-s een-dee-vee-doo-al-MEN-t, mahz tam-BAYNG PEL-oo am-bee-EN-t k KEH-roo kree-AR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Há dias em que quero desaparecer um pouco e outros em que quero abrir o espaço.
exampleSentences.english: There are days when I want to disappear a little and others when I want to open up the space.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The issue with some trends is not that they are bold, but that they feel disconnected from real movement and real weather.
portuguese: O problema com algumas tendências não é serem ousadas, mas parecerem desligadas do movimento real e do tempo real.
pronunciationNote: oo proh-BLAY-mah kong al-GOO-mash ten-DEN-see-ash nown eh seh-REHNG ow-ZAH-dash, mahz pah-reh-SEH-reng deezh-lee-GAH-dash doo moh-vee-MEN-too rreh-AL ee doo TEM-poo rreh-AL

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se uma peça só funciona parada ou em fotografia, não me convence muito.
exampleSentences.english: If a piece only works standing still or in photos, it does not convince me much.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I appreciate clothes that hold their shape without feeling stiff or overly engineered.
portuguese: Dou valor a roupa que mantém a forma sem ficar rígida ou demasiado construída.
pronunciationNote: doh vah-LOR ah ROH-pah k man-TAYNG ah FOR-mah seng fee-KAR REE-zhee-dah oo deh-mah-zee-AH-doo konsh-troo-EE-dah
notes: Useful in style and tailoring discussions.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a estrutura é boa, o corpo agradece e o olhar também.
exampleSentences.english: If the structure is good, the body appreciates it and so does the eye.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I would rather slightly underdress and feel like myself than overdress and feel performative.
portuguese: Prefiro vestir-me um pouco abaixo do tom e sentir-me eu do que exagerar e parecer que estou a representar.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo veesh-TEER-m oom POH-koo ah-BY-shoo doo tom ee seen-TEER-m eh-oo doo k eh-zah-zheh-RAR ee pah-reh-SAIR k esh-TOH ah rreh-preh-zeng-TAR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a roupa me afasta demasiado de mim, raramente ganho alguma coisa com isso.
exampleSentences.english: If the clothes take me too far away from myself, I rarely gain anything from that.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: What flatters me most is usually not what draws the most attention at first glance.
portuguese: Aquilo que mais me favorece normalmente não é o que chama mais a atenção à primeira vista.
pronunciationNote: ah-KEE-loo k mysh m fah-voh-REH-s nor-mal-MEN-t nown eh oo k SHAH-mah mysh ah ah-ten-SOWN ah pree-MAIR-ah VEESH-tah
notes: Useful in style and changing-room conversations.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Às vezes o que dura melhor é precisamente o que parece menos ansioso por impressionar.
exampleSentences.english: Sometimes what lasts best is exactly what seems less anxious to impress.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I like personal style most when it feels edited rather than merely expensive.
portuguese: Gosto mais de estilo pessoal quando parece pensado e editado, e não apenas caro.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too mysh d esh-TEE-loo peh-soh-AL KWAN-doo pah-REH-s pen-SAH-doo ee eh-dee-TAH-doo, ee nown ah-PEH-nash KAH-roo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nem tudo precisa de ser vistoso para ter intenção.
exampleSentences.english: Not everything needs to be showy to feel intentional.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I have much more patience for visible wear than for clothes that never sat right to begin with.
portuguese: Tenho muito mais paciência para sinais de uso do que para roupa que nunca assentou bem desde o início.
pronunciationNote: TEN-yoo MOOY-too mysh pah-see-EN-see-ah PAH-rah see-NYESH d OO-zoo doo k PAH-rah ROH-pah k NOON-kah ah-sen-TOH beng DEHZ-d oo ee-NEE-see-oo
notes: Useful in wardrobe and style conversations.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Uma peça vivida ainda pode ter história; uma peça errada cansa logo.
exampleSentences.english: A lived-in piece can still have a story; a wrong piece gets tiring immediately.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I often decide what to wear by starting with the shoes, because they set the tone for everything else.
portuguese: Muitas vezes decido o que vestir começando pelos sapatos, porque eles definem o tom do resto.
pronunciationNote: MOOY-tash VAY-zesh deh-SEE-doo oo k veesh-TEER koh-MEH-san-doo PEL-oosh sah-PAH-toosh, poor-k AY-loosh deh-FEE-nyeng oo tom doo RRESH-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se o corpo começa bem assente, o resto organiza-se muito mais depressa.
exampleSentences.english: If the body starts out well grounded, the rest comes together much faster.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The haircut I usually want is not dramatic change, but better structure and less visual noise.
portuguese: O corte que normalmente quero não é uma mudança dramática, mas melhor estrutura e menos ruído visual.
pronunciationNote: oo KOR-t k nor-mal-MEN-t KEH-roo nown eh OO-mah moo-DAN-sah drah-MAH-tee-kah, mahz meh-LYOR esh-troo-TOO-rah ee MEN-oosh roo-EE-doo vee-zhoo-AL
notes: Useful at the hairdresser or barber.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando o corte simplifica sem apagar a pessoa, para mim funciona melhor.
exampleSentences.english: When the cut simplifies without erasing the person, it works better for me.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I prefer accessories that feel integrated rather than ones that look added at the last minute.
portuguese: Prefiro acessórios que parecem integrados em vez de outros que parecem postos à última hora.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se um acessório interrompe o conjunto em vez de o completar, perco o interesse.
exampleSentences.english: If an accessory interrupts the outfit instead of completing it, I lose interest.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: A lot of what makes someone stylish is not the clothes themselves, but the ease with which they wear them.
portuguese: Muito daquilo que faz alguém parecer elegante não é a roupa em si, mas a naturalidade com que a usa.
pronunciationNote: MOOY-too dah-KEE-loo k faz al-GANG pah-reh-SAIR eh-leh-GAN-t nown eh ah ROH-pah eng s, mahz ah nah-too-rah-lee-DAH-d kong k ah OO-zah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando a peça parece pousar no corpo em vez de o dominar, nota-se logo.
exampleSentences.english: When a piece seems to rest on the body rather than dominate it, you notice immediately.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I am wary of buying clothes for a version of my life that does not really exist.
portuguese: Desconfio de comprar roupa para uma versão da minha vida que, na verdade, não existe assim tanto.
pronunciationNote: desh-kon-FEE-oo d kom-PRAR ROH-pah PAH-rah OO-mah vair-SOWN dah MEE-nyah VEE-dah k, nah vair-DAH-d, nown ek-ZEESH-t ah-SEENG TAN-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se compro para uma fantasia, a peça quase sempre fica parada no armário.
exampleSentences.english: If I buy for a fantasy version of life, the piece almost always stays in the wardrobe.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I usually trust mirrors less than movement when I am deciding whether something really works.
portuguese: Normalmente confio menos no espelho do que no movimento quando estou a decidir se uma peça funciona mesmo.
pronunciationNote: nor-mal-MEN-t kon-FEE-oo MEN-oosh noo esh-PEH-lyoo doo k noo moh-vee-MEN-too KWAN-doo esh-TOH ah deh-see-DEER s OO-mah PESS-ah foon-see-OH-nah MAY-zmoo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se só parece bem parado, raramente aguenta o dia inteiro.
exampleSentences.english: If it only looks good standing still, it rarely works for a whole day.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The best compliments are usually the ones that notice alignment, not effort.
portuguese: Os melhores elogios costumam ser os que notam alinhamento e não esforço.
pronunciationNote: oosh meh-LYOH-resh eh-LOH-zhee-oosh koosh-TOO-mang sair oosh k NOH-tang ah-leen-yah-MEN-too ee nown esh-FOR-soo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando alguém diz que aquilo parece mesmo teu, isso vale mais do que um elogio genérico.
exampleSentences.english: When someone says that it really looks like you, that matters more than a generic compliment.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I tend to dress better when I think in textures and proportions, not only in categories of clothes.
portuguese: Costumo vestir-me melhor quando penso em texturas e proporções, e não apenas em categorias de roupa.
pronunciationNote: koosh-TOO-mah veesh-TEER-m meh-LYOR KWAN-doo PEN-soo eng teks-TOO-rash ee proh-por-SOINSH, ee nown ah-PEH-nash eng kah-teh-GOH-ree-ash d ROH-pah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando penso só em peças soltas, perco a relação entre elas.
exampleSentences.english: When I think only in separate pieces, I lose the relationship between them.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I do not need everything to match exactly, but I do need the tensions in an outfit to feel intentional.
portuguese: Não preciso que tudo combine exatamente, mas preciso que as tensões do conjunto pareçam intencionais.
pronunciationNote: nown preh-SEE-zoo k TOO-doo kom-BEE-n eh-zak-tah-MEN-t, mahz preh-SEE-zoo k az ten-SOINSH doo kon-ZHOON-too pah-REH-sang een-ten-see-oh-NAISH

exampleSentences.portuguese: Uma pequena dissonância pode dar vida, desde que não pareça acidente.
exampleSentences.english: A small dissonance can bring something to life, as long as it does not look accidental.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I like style advice best when it helps me notice myself more clearly rather than copy someone else.
portuguese: Gosto mais de conselhos de estilo quando me ajudam a ver-me com mais clareza e não a copiar outra pessoa.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too mysh d kon-SAY-lyoosh d esh-TEE-loo KWAN-doo m ah-ZHOO-dang ah VER-m kong mysh klah-REH-zah ee nown ah koh-pee-AR OH-trah peh-SOH-ah
notes: Useful in conversations about style development.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a referência apaga a pessoa, deixa de ser orientação e passa a ser molde.
exampleSentences.english: If the reference erases the person, it stops being guidance and becomes a mould.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The line between expressive and overdone is often just whether the person seems at ease in it.
portuguese: A linha entre expressivo e exagerado muitas vezes está apenas em a pessoa parecer à vontade naquilo.
pronunciationNote: ah LEE-nyah EN-tr ehk-spreh-SEE-voo ee eh-zah-zheh-RAH-doo MOOY-tash VAY-zesh esh-TAH ah-PEH-nash eng ah peh-SOH-ah pah-reh-SAIR ah von-TAH-d nah-KEE-loo

exampleSentences.portuguese: A mesma peça pode parecer forçada numa pessoa e inevitável noutra.
exampleSentences.english: The same piece can look forced on one person and inevitable on another.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I am increasingly interested in clothes that age well rather than clothes that peak immediately.
portuguese: Interessa-me cada vez mais roupa que envelhece bem do que roupa que atinge o pico logo no início.
pronunciationNote: een-teh-REH-sah-m KAH-dah vez mysh ROH-pah k en-vel-YEH-s beng doo k ROH-pah k ah-TEEN-zh oo PEE-koo LOH-goo noo ee-NEE-see-oo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se uma peça fica mais interessante com o tempo, tende a ficar comigo também.
exampleSentences.english: If a piece becomes more interesting over time, it tends to stay with me too.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I do not think confidence comes from dressing up; I think it comes from reducing friction between self-image and reality.
portuguese: Não acho que a confiança venha de nos arranjarmos; acho que vem de reduzir a fricção entre a imagem que temos e a realidade.
pronunciationNote: nown AH-shoo k ah kon-fee-AN-sah VEN-yah d noosh ah-ran-ZHAR-moosh; AH-shoo k veng d rreh-doo-ZEER ah freek-SOWN EN-tr ah EE-mah-zheng k TEH-moosh ee ah rreh-ah-lee-DAH-d
notes: Useful in reflective conversations about appearance.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando o exterior e o interior deixam de discutir, o corpo descansa.
exampleSentences.english: When the exterior and interior stop arguing, the body relaxes.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The hairstyles that suit me best are usually the ones that make maintenance easier rather than more elaborate.
portuguese: Os penteados que melhor me ficam costumam ser os que tornam a manutenção mais simples e não mais elaborada.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se um corte só funciona com demasiado esforço, não dura na minha rotina.
exampleSentences.english: If a haircut only works with too much effort, it does not last in my routine.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I would rather alter one good piece properly than keep buying cheaper versions that never quite sit right.
portuguese: Prefiro ajustar bem uma boa peça do que continuar a comprar versões mais baratas que nunca assentam realmente.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo ah-zhoosh-TAR beng OO-mah BOH-ah PESS-ah doo k kon-tee-NOO-ahr ah kom-PRAR vair-SOINSH mysh bah-RAH-tash k NOON-kah ah-SEN-tang rreh-al-MEN-t

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando a base é certa, vale a pena afiná-la em vez de recomeçar.
exampleSentences.english: When the base is right, it is worth refining it instead of starting again.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I like a look that suggests intention without looking over-managed.
portuguese: Gosto de um visual que sugere intenção sem parecer demasiado controlado.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too d oom vee-zhoo-AL k soo-ZHEH-r een-ten-SOWN seng pah-reh-SAIR deh-mah-zee-AH-doo kon-troh-LAH-doo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quero que se note escolha, mas não excesso de supervisão.
exampleSentences.english: I want there to be a sense of choice, but not of over-supervision.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The most useful thing a salesperson can tell me is not what is fashionable, but what actually changes the fit.
portuguese: A coisa mais útil que alguém da loja me pode dizer não é o que está na moda, mas o que muda realmente o caimento.
pronunciationNote: ah KOY-zah mysh OO-teel k al-GANG dah LOH-zhah m PODE dee-ZAIR nown eh oo k esh-TAH nah MOH-dah, mahz oo k MOO-dah rreh-al-MEN-t oo kai-men-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se percebo o que está a mudar no corpo, decido muito melhor.
exampleSentences.english: If I understand what is changing on the body, I decide much better.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I think personal style becomes clearer when you stop asking what you should wear and start asking what keeps returning.
portuguese: Acho que o estilo pessoal fica mais claro quando deixamos de perguntar o que devíamos vestir e passamos a notar o que volta sempre.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Os padrões repetidos dizem-nos mais do que as ideias isoladas.
exampleSentences.english: Repeated patterns tell us more than isolated ideas.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I have less patience now for clothes that need constant vigilance to stay looking right.
portuguese: Tenho menos paciência agora para roupa que precisa de vigilância constante para continuar a parecer bem.
pronunciationNote: TEN-yoo MEN-oosh pah-see-EN-see-ah ah-GOH-rah PAH-rah ROH-pah k preh-SEE-zah d vee-zhee-LAN-see-ah konsh-TAN-t PAH-rah kon-tee-NOO-ahr ah pah-reh-SAIR beng

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se tenho de a corrigir a cada dez minutos, não me está realmente a servir.
exampleSentences.english: If I have to fix it every ten minutes, it is not really serving me.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I prefer makeup or styling that works with my face rather than trying to override it completely.
portuguese: Prefiro maquilhagem ou styling que trabalhe com o meu rosto em vez de tentar anulá-lo por completo.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo mah-kee-LYAH-zheng oo styling k trah-BAH-lyeh kong oo may-oo ROSH-too eng vez d ten-TAR ah-noo-LAH-loo poor kong-PLEH-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando tudo está em luta com a pessoa, raramente parece natural.
exampleSentences.english: When everything is fighting with the person, it rarely looks natural.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The pieces I value most are often the ones that quietly solve a lot of problems at once.
portuguese: As peças que mais valorizo são muitas vezes as que resolvem em silêncio muitos problemas ao mesmo tempo.
pronunciationNote: azh PESS-ash k mysh vah-loh-REE-zoo sown MOOY-tash VAY-zesh az k rreh-zol-VENG eng see-LAN-see-oo MOOY-toosh proh-BLAY-mash ow MAYZ-moo TEM-poo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Caimento, versatilidade e conforto juntos valem mais do que qualquer detalhe isolado.
exampleSentences.english: Fit, versatility, and comfort together matter more than any isolated detail.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I usually know something is right when I stop thinking about the item itself and start thinking about where I would go in it.
portuguese: Normalmente sei que uma peça está certa quando deixo de pensar nela e começo a pensar em onde iria com ela.
pronunciationNote: nor-mal-MEN-t say k OO-mah PESS-ah esh-TAH SER-tah KWAN-doo DAY-shoo d pen-SAR NAY-lah ee koh-MEH-soo ah pen-SAR eng ON-d ee-REE-ah kong EH-lah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a imagino logo em contexto, quase nunca me engano.
exampleSentences.english: If I immediately imagine it in context, I am almost never wrong.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I am more interested in silhouette these days than in decorative detail.
portuguese: Ultimamente interessa-me mais a silhueta do que o detalhe decorativo.
pronunciationNote: ool-tee-mah-MEN-t een-teh-REH-sah-m mysh ah see-loo-EH-tah doo k oo deh-TAH-ly deh-koh-rah-TEE-voo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a forma está certa, muitas vezes o resto pode ser muito contido.
exampleSentences.english: If the shape is right, the rest can often be very restrained.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I think people often confuse looking expensive with looking considered.
portuguese: Acho que muitas vezes se confunde parecer caro com parecer pensado.
pronunciationNote: AH-shoo k MOOY-tash VAY-zesh s kon-FOON-d pah-reh-SAIR KAH-roo kong pah-reh-SAIR pen-SAH-doo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Uma imagem cuidada não depende necessariamente de preço alto.
exampleSentences.english: A considered image does not necessarily depend on a high price.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: If a haircut only works freshly done, I do not consider it a particularly good haircut for my life.
portuguese: Se um corte só funciona acabado de fazer, não o considero um corte particularmente bom para a minha vida.
pronunciationNote: s oom KOR-t soh foon-see-OH-nah ah-kah-BAH-doo d fah-ZAIR, nown oo kon-see-DEH-roo oom KOR-t pahr-tee-koo-lahr-MEN-t bong PAH-rah ah MEE-nyah VEE-dah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Preciso que a forma aguente o tempo e o crescimento, não só o momento do espelho.
exampleSentences.english: I need the shape to survive time and growth, not just the moment in the mirror.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The older I get, the more I see style as editing rather than accumulation.
portuguese: Quanto mais velho fico, mais vejo o estilo como edição e não como acumulação.
pronunciationNote: KWAN-too mysh VEL-yoo FEE-koo, mysh VEH-zhoo oo esh-TEE-loo KOH-moo eh-dee-SOWN ee nown KOH-moo ah-koo-moo-lah-SOWN

exampleSentences.portuguese: Tirar excesso tornou-se para mim mais importante do que somar novidade.
exampleSentences.english: Removing excess has become more important to me than adding novelty.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I prefer compliments that feel observant rather than generic, because they tell me what is actually working.
portuguese: Prefiro elogios que parecem atentos e não genéricos, porque me dizem o que está realmente a funcionar.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo eh-LOH-zhee-oosh k pah-REH-seng ah-TEN-toosh ee nown zheh-NEH-ree-koosh, poor-k m DEE-zeng oo k esh-TAH rreh-al-MEN-t ah foon-see-oh-NAR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando alguém nota a proporção ou a cor certa, isso ajuda-me muito mais.
exampleSentences.english: When someone notices the right proportion or colour, that helps me much more.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I want clothes to support presence, not replace it.
portuguese: Quero que a roupa apoie a presença, não que a substitua.
pronunciationNote: KEH-roo k ah ROH-pah ah-POI-ah ah preh-ZEN-sah, nown k ah soob-stee-TOO-ah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a imagem fala antes da pessoa, alguma coisa fica desequilibrada.
exampleSentences.english: If the image speaks before the person, something becomes unbalanced.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The pieces I regret least are usually the ones I can imagine wearing in three slightly different versions of myself.
portuguese: As peças de que menos me arrependo costumam ser as que consigo imaginar em três versões um pouco diferentes de mim.
pronunciationNote: azh PESS-ash d k MEN-oosh m ah-rreh-PEN-doo koosh-TOO-mang sair az k kon-SEE-goo ee-mah-zhee-NAR eng trays vair-SOINSH oom POH-koo dee-feh-REN-tesh d meeng

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se uma peça viaja bem entre contextos, quase nunca me desilude.
exampleSentences.english: If a piece travels well between contexts, it almost never disappoints me.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I am more persuaded by a quiet, well-cut piece than by something loudly trying to be original.
portuguese: Convence-me mais uma peça discreta e bem cortada do que algo a tentar muito alto ser original.
pronunciationNote: kon-VEN-s-m mysh OO-mah PESS-ah deesh-KREH-tah ee beng kor-TAH-dah doo k AL-goo ah ten-TAR MOOY-too AL-too sair or-ee-zhee-NAL

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se uma peça está segura da sua forma, não precisa de gritar.
exampleSentences.english: If a piece is secure in its shape, it does not need to shout.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: I think looking put together is often more about proportion and rhythm than about owning the right pieces.
portuguese: Acho que parecer composto tem muitas vezes mais a ver com proporção e ritmo do que com ter as peças certas.
pronunciationNote: AH-shoo k pah-reh-SAIR kom-POHS-too teng MOOY-tash VAY-zesh mysh ah vair kong proh-por-SOWN ee REET-moo doo k kong tair az PESS-ash SER-tash

exampleSentences.portuguese: As mesmas peças podem parecer planas ou vivas dependendo de como se relacionam.
exampleSentences.english: The same pieces can seem flat or alive depending on how they relate.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: The best version of personal style, for me, is when it feels inevitable rather than assembled.
portuguese: A melhor versão de estilo pessoal, para mim, é quando parece inevitável e não montado.
pronunciationNote: ah meh-LYOR vair-SOWN d esh-TEE-loo peh-soh-AL, PAH-rah meeng, eh KWAN-doo pah-REH-s ee-neh-vee-TAH-vel ee nown mon-TAH-doo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quase como se a roupa tivesse chegado ali naturalmente com a pessoa.
exampleSentences.english: Almost as if the clothes had arrived there naturally with the person.

subject: Appearance, Clothing & Personal Style
english: If something makes me stand differently, move differently, and think differently, then it is affecting much more than appearance.
portuguese: Se algo me faz estar de outra maneira, mover-me de outra forma e pensar de forma diferente, então está a mexer em muito mais do que a aparência.
pronunciationNote: s AL-goo m faz esh-TAR d OH-trah mah-NAY-rah, moh-VAIR-m d OH-trah FOR-mah ee pen-SAR d FOR-mah dee-feh-REN-t, en-TOWN esh-TAH ah meh-SHAIR eng MOOY-too mysh doo k ah ah-pah-REN-see-ah
notes: Useful in reflective conversations about clothing and self-image.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Por isso levo a roupa mais a sério do que parece à primeira vista.
exampleSentences.english: That is why I take clothing more seriously than it may seem at first glance.
